title: Lord Of Mysteries S01
summary: A Victorian supernatural anime adventure filled with mystery, powers, and hidden organizations.
author: Kidz Cartoons Hub
content:
Zhou Mingrui wakes up in a Victorian-style world as Klein Moretti, where steam technology, divination, potions, and supernatural powers shape a dangerous hidden society.

As he rises through mysterious abilities and secret organizations, he uncovers a conspiracy that threatens the world.

title: Detective Conan: The Lost Case
summary: A new adventure for Conan where every clue brings him closer to the truth.
author: Kidz Cartoons Hub
content:
Conan Edogawa returns in a gripping special where a missing artifact hides a dangerous secret.

With each clue, the stakes grow higher, and only the world's greatest young detective can solve the lost case.

title: Tom & Jerry Classic Collection
summary: The timeless chase continues with a fresh collection of cartoons for kids and families.
author: Kidz Cartoons Hub
content:
Tom and Jerry return in a funny collection of classic chases, tricks, and cartoon chaos.

Enjoy more than a dozen episodes designed for children and families who love bright animation and laughter.

title: Motu Patlu Ka Goa Dhamaal
summary: Motu and Patlu, two friends living in Furfuri Nagar, always get themselves into hilarious situations and later rescued merely by luck, using the help from Ghasita Ram, Inspector Chingam and Dr. Jhatka.
author: Kidz Cartoons Hub
